notes.title: Patch v0.51
notes.content:
Hey everyone. Fixing a few goofs that were released in the last version, including a bug where the player Volume preference was set to 0.


Here we go.

[b]PATCH NOTES v. 0.51[/b]

[b]--Fixed--[/b]

[list]
[*]Music should be on by Default.

[*]Audio should be 100% by Default.

[*]Heroes respawning would sometimes get stuck flopping around the ground indefinately.

[*]Heroes attacks getting stuck after a Revive.

[*]Raptors would 'melt' after dying. Into a gooey pile of Raptor parts.

[*]Decreased distance zoomed-in when entering vehicle.

[*]Slightly higher resistance to stumbling. Slightly.

[*]Typos in the Hero Select Screen.

[*]Adjusted Fly Cam speeds and rotations. 
[/list] 


[I]NEW FEATURE:[/I] The Fly Cam (Default Hotkey J) can now lock onto a target enemy or hero body, even while time is stopped. Press E to lock on during Fly Cam Mode, and E again to unlock. Great for screenshot.

[b]--HEROES--[/b]
[list]
[*]Lil Pete's Knockback ability was, while hilarious, keeping him from moving and not really doing anything.

[*]Adjusted several attack animations, sound effects, and speed.

[*]Heroes selected customization options should now display correctly in-game.
[/list]

If you guys have any requests, questions, comments, FEEL FREE to comment or post in the Community. I'm happy to chat when I get the chance.

-Deejay
